h1: Shopify Product Image Generator for Store Pages
lead: Your shop's AI product photo generator can make a Shopify product image in a room you never rented, then place that file on the product page.

faq.q: What is a Shopify product photo tool?
faq.a: It builds a Shopify product photo from a picture you already shot, so the product page can go up without a location day.

faq.q: How does a Shopify product photo get made?
faq.a: Upload the product and say where you want it, such as the bowls on a light table. You get a file back, and you can ask for more light before you download.

faq.q: Which photo tool should a Shopify store use?
faq.a: Use one that restages your real product, holds a consistent look across the grid, and hands you a file you upload yourself. AIVideosUGC shows the cost before the photo runs. The finished file is ready for your store.

faq.q: Can I make Shopify product photos without paying?
faq.a: No. Every photo spends credits on a paid monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. There is no zero-cost way to run a photo.

faq.q: Are these photos a fit for a Shopify store?
faq.a: Yes. The same product photo can sit on the Shopify page and in a paid post. You spend credits, not a location fee.

faq.q: What does a Shopify product photo tool give you?
faq.a: You get another scene when the collection needs one, and you can take the old background off a phone photo before that scene is made.

faq.q: Can I use the photos on my store and in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download can go on the product page and in your ads, with no watermark. You still need the right to use the photo you uploaded. The terms you accepted with the plan cover the file.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit photo of the whole item, like the ceramic bowls with every bowl in frame. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) shows what kind of photo works.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection together?
faq.a: Yes. Run many products in one batch so the grid shares a look. Each file spends credits, and the cost shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits come back.

reasons.h2: Why Stores Skip the Photo Shoot
reasons.lead: The next Shopify product photo does not need a location, a model, or a prop rental.

items.d: A product photo is 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. The charge shows before you start, so you can budget the reshoot.
Upload tonight and put a file on the product page, even when the photographer's next open morning is weeks away.

items.t: A Whole Grid in One Run
items.d: Generate Shopify product photos for many products together when the grid needs a refresh. It is closer to restocking the page than booking another location.
The new Shopify photo can show the product on a wooden chair you never bought, and nobody has to be booked to sit in it.
Export a new Shopify product photo late at night, after the orders are packed, when the studio you used to rent is closed.
Make one frame in a dim room and one in a bright hallway, then keep the Shopify photo that matches the collection.
